propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table has only one entry (us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7) but measurement shows temperature deprecation is family-wide across the opus line and affects both us.* and global.* prefixes, leaving the default model claude-opus-4-8 unguarded.

The default model claude-opus-4-8 is rebar's config.py DEFAULT_MODEL, and when any temperature is configured it will hard-fail with ValidationException on both Bedrock and Anthropic paths because the override table does not cover the bare id or the global.* prefix variant.
Temperature parameter is not fully unsupported on opus models—temp=1.0 (API default) succeeds while 0.0 and 0.5 fail, indicating explicit non-default sampling is deprecated, not the parameter itself.

Code-review Pass-2 deliberately pins temperature=0 for determinism, but the missing override causes the parameter to be silently dropped on Anthropic path and hard-fails on Bedrock path, leading to unguarded resampling in production.
The top_p parameter is also deprecated on opus-4-8 models but has no supports_top_p capability record, creating a latent defect that becomes live when rebar sets top_p.
The override table must cover bare model ids (claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7) and both profile-prefixed variants (us.*, global.*) to guard both Anthropic and Bedrock code paths.
